as_told.title: Pablo Amaringo's flying saucers as vehicles for the spirit world

plain: A man in the Peruvian Amazon named Pablo Amaringo once said, quite casually, that flying saucers are "vehicles for entering and leaving the spirit world." The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels this on two shows, passing on what Amaringo told him, and points to his own books Supernatural and Visionary for it. In one telling Hancock puts it around 2005, in the other more loosely in the 1990s or 2000s; if Amaringo is right, the saucers would belong to the world of visions, not to outer space.
